claim: Bistrot la Coulemelle (Marcon bistrot) is at Rue du Vivarais, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid, open Thursday to Monday (closed Tue/Wed), 50 seats, Bib Gourmand.
quote: Adresse: Rue du Vivarais 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid... Ouvert du jeudi au lundi, Fermé mardi et mercredi... Capacité: 50 places... BIB Gourmand

claim: The Marcon family ecosystem in Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid includes a gastronomic restaurant, family bistrot, Bar de Païs, La Chanterelle bakery, Relais & Châteaux hotel, gîtes d'étape, Spa du Haut Plateau, cooking school and a shop.
quote: Restaurants & Dining: Gastronomic restaurant, Family bistrot, Bar de Païs... Bakery: La Chanterelle... Hotels (Relais Château and Logis de France 3-star)... Spa du Haut Plateau... Cooking school... Shop/Boutique

claim: Cave (Vins) Marcon at 46 rue du Velay sells fine wines, local products and beers, open Mon-Sat 9-12:30/14:30-19 and Sun/holidays 9:30-12:30/15-19, with group tastings by appointment.
quote: 46, rue du Velay, 43290 Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid... Monday-Saturday: 9:00-12:30, 14:30-19:00; Sunday & holidays: 9:30-12:30, 15:00-19:00... Vins fins, boissons, bières spéciales, produits locaux... Dégustations de groupes sur rendez-vous

claim: Cave Marcon partnered with distiller Bérenger Mayoux in Solignac-sur-Loire to launch their own artisanal liqueur 'La Grande Verveine', using verbena from Jacques Marcon's gardens.
quote: La Cave Marcon lance sa propre liqueur artisanale, la Grande Verveine... partenariat avec Bérenger Mayoux, distillateur à Solignac-sur-Loire... la verveine provient des jardins de Jacques Marcon

claim: Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid's Foire aux Champignons is scheduled for 7-8 November 2026 — not relevant for a May visit but confirms the village's mushroom identity.
quote: La prochaine foire aux champignons aura lieu les 7 et 8 novembre 2026

claim: Yssingeaux has three markets: Thursday 7-13h (producers/regional), a Saturday bovine fair 12-19h, and a Sunday producer market 7-13h.
quote: marché de producteurs le dimanche de 7h à 13h, une foire bovins le samedi de 12h à 19h, et un marché le jeudi de 7h à 13h

claim: Saint-Agrève holds its weekly market on Monday mornings 8-13h at Place Félise d'Asseyne, plus a Thursday evening producer market 17-19h from May to September.
quote: Le marché de Saint-Agrève se tient toute l'année, tous les lundis de 8h à 13h... un marché de producteurs locaux a lieu du 21 mai au 17 septembre 2026 le jeudi entre 17h et 19h

claim: Annonay's Saturday market runs 8:00-13:15 at Place de la Liberté/Rue Montgolfier with all types of commerce; main market days are Wednesday and Saturday, with no Sunday market in Annonay itself but a Sunday market 7-12:30 at neighbouring Boulieu-lès-Annonay.
quote: Saturday market runs from 8:00 AM to 1:15 PM at Place de la Liberté and Rue Montgolfier... Annonay market operates on Wednesdays and Saturdays only... market in Boulieu-lès-Annonay every Sunday from 7:00 AM to 12:30 PM

claim: The closest Sunday market to Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is Lalouvesc (~9-10 km), 7-13h, with Devesset (Wed) and Montfaucon-en-Velay (Tue) as other weekday options.
quote: In Lalouvesc (approximately 9-10 kilometers from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid), there is a market on Sundays from 7am to 1pm... Devesset: Wednesday market from 8am to 1pm... Montfaucon-en-Velay: Tuesday market

claim: Tence (~15 km from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid) holds its weekly market on Tuesday mornings only (7-12h), Boulevard Léon Rocher / Place du Chatiague — no regular weekend market.
quote: The market in Tence takes place Tuesday mornings year-round... Boulevard Léon Rocher, Place du Chatiague, 43190 Tence... 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM on Tuesdays

claim: Fourme de Montbrison AOP is made by 7 dairies (3 industrial + 4 farmhouse) using cow's milk from 33 Haut-Forez communes above 700 m altitude, with several producers open for visits and farm shops.
quote: The milk is transformed by 7 fromageries (3 dairy and 4 farmhouse producers), open for visits throughout the year... cow's milk collected from 33 communes of Haut Forez at over 700 meters altitude

claim: Fromagerie Artisanale des Hautes Chaumes in Sauvain (Monts du Forez, Loire) produces Fourme de Montbrison AOP, tommes and tommettes, founded 1999 by Hubert Tarit with input from MOF Hervé Mons.
quote: Founded in 1999 by Hubert TARIT in Sauvain in Monts du Forez (Loire, 42), with expertise from Hervé Mons, Meilleur Ouvrier de France, they produce artisanal cheeses including the emblematic Fourme de Montbrison AOP

claim: Picodon AOP is a goat-milk cheese from Ardèche and Drôme; the AOP body maintains a producer map with farms offering direct sales and farm visits, many open seasonally.
quote: Les producteurs de Picodon AOP | Carte et adresses... vente directe... visite à la ferme

claim: Lentille Verte du Puy AOP (since 2008, the first European pulse to obtain AOP) is grown 600-1,200 m altitude on volcanic soils across 87 Velay communes, with producers like David Vigouroux (Saint-Haon) and Myriam Rivet.
quote: 1ère légumineuse européenne à avoir obtenu une AOP... entre 600 et 1 200 m d'altitude sur 87 communes et sur des sols à dominante volcanique

claim: Châtaigne d'Ardèche AOP covers 118 Ardèche communes (Saint-Agrève included) plus 7 Gard + 2 Drôme, with the comité interprofessionnel listing producteurs-transformateurs open to visitors and a Maison du Châtaignier at Saint-Pierreville.
quote: L'AOP Châtaigne d'Ardèche couvre 118 communes de l'Ardèche, 7 du Gard et 2 de la Drôme... Saint-Agrève est notamment une des communes incluses... La Maison du châtaignier est située à Saint-Pierreville

claim: The Saint-Joseph AOC stretches along the right bank of the Rhône through Mauves and Tournon — about 50 km / 52 min drive from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid (just outside the 30 km radius but reachable as a day-trip), and the Doux river from Saint-Bonnet flows down to the 'Sainte-Épine' terroir within the appellation.
quote: The Doux river takes its source at Saint-Bonnet and descends the beautiful Ardèche slopes down to 'Sainte-Épine,' one of the greatest terroirs of the appellation

claim: Tournon-sur-Rhône (heart of Saint-Joseph wine tourism) is ~50 km / 52 min by car from Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid.
quote: The distance between Tournon-sur-Rhône and Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is 41 miles, with a road distance of 31 miles... The fastest way to get from Tournon-sur-Rhône to Saint-Bonnet-le-Froid is to drive which takes 52 min
